scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/config/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/observability/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/mobile/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: bun test packages/config/src packages/domain/src packages/observability/src apps/api/src apps/worker/src apps/mobile/src && cd apps/mobile && bun run test:ui
scripts.build: bun run build:api && bun run build:mobile
scripts.build:mobile: mkdir -p dist/mobile/assets && cd apps/mobile && bunx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output ../../dist/mobile/index.android.bundle --assets-dest ../../dist/mobile/assets
